blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `refreshCartPromotionAdjustmentsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow recomputes the adjustments of a cart's line items and shipping methods
from the cart's current state, and replaces the existing adjustments with them. It's used
by the [updateCartPromotionsWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/updateCartPromotionsWorkflow) to apply the cart's promotions, and again to recompute
the adjustments after the cart's shipping methods are re-priced.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you to
recompute a cart's adjustments after making changes that affect them.

steps.name: getActionsToComputeFromPromotionsStep
steps.description:
This step retrieves the actions to compute based on the promotions
applied on items and shipping methods.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve items and shipping methods' details.

:::

steps.name: prepareAdjustmentsFromPromotionActionsStep
steps.description:
This step prepares the line item or shipping method adjustments using
actions computed by the Promotion Module.

steps.name: removeLineItemAdjustmentsStep
steps.description: This step removes line item adjustments from a cart.

steps.name: removeShippingMethodAdjustmentsStep
steps.description: This step removes shipping method adjustments from a cart.

steps.name: createLineItemAdjustmentsStep
steps.description: This step creates line item adjustments in a cart, such as when a promotion is applied.

steps.name: createShippingMethodAdjustmentsStep
steps.description: This step creates shipping method adjustments for a cart.

steps.name: updateCartPromotionsStep
steps.description: This step updates the promotions applied on a cart.

children.name: cart
children.description: The cart, if already retrieved. If not provided, the cart is retrieved by its ID.

children.name: promo_codes
children.description: The promotion codes to apply to the cart. They replace the cart's existing promotions.

children.name: additional_promotion_context
children.description: Custom context merged on top of the cart context when evaluating promotion rules.

children.name: code
children.description: The promotion code that was skipped.

children.name: reason
children.description:
The reason the promotion code was skipped.
- `promotion_limit_exceeded`: the promotion's usage limit has been reached.
- `campaign_budget_exceeded`: the promotion's campaign budget has been exhausted.
